verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own user-defined rules that fire actions automatically on spend events: approval routing by vendor type, category or dollar amount, notification workflows keyed to spend amount or team role, auto-approval of in-policy expenses, and customizable auto-approve policies for agents. These rules are confined to approval, routing and notification inside finance workflows, and the evidence is marketing-level; webhooks are only a developer building block and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event→action rule builder with configurable triggers and action types, detailed first-party docs on rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
